cltranslation: And he spread his tent (with) Bethel ( being to the) west and Ai (being to the) east.

cltranslation: And it shall be (thus): he will be a mouth for you and you will be a god to him.

clhebrew: לֹֽא־יָמִ֞ישׁ עַמּ֤וּד הֶֽעָנָן֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְעַמּ֥וּד הָאֵ֖שׁ לָ֑יְלָה לִפְנֵ֖י הָעָֽם

cltranslation: And all of Pharoah’s chariotry, his horsemen, and his army caught up to them camping near Pi Hahiroth in front of Baal Tsaphon.

cltranslation: Is this not the word which we spoke to you in Egypt, saying...

clhebrew: וּרְאוּ֙ אֶת־יְשׁוּעַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם

cltranslation: Although you have seen the Egyptians today, you will never see them again.

clhebrew: וַיּ֣וֹלֶךְ יְהוָ֣ה ׀ אֶת־הַ֠יָּם בְּר֨וּחַ קָדִ֤ים עַזָּה֙ כָּל־הַלַּ֔יְלָה

cltranslation: And Yahweh moved (back) the sea with a strong east wind the whole night (long).

cltranslation: For (in) six days Yahweh made the heavens and the earth, the sea and all that (is) in them.

clhebrew: וְכָל־הָעָם֩ רֹאִ֨ים אֶת־הַקּוֹלֹ֜ת וְאֶת־הַלַּפִּידִ֗ם וְאֵת֙ ק֣וֹל הַשֹּׁפָ֔ר וְאֶת־הָהָ֖ר עָשֵׁ֑ן
SBL_cltransliteration: wəkol-hāʿām rōʾîm ʾet-haqqôlōt wəʾet-hallappîdim wəʾēt qôl haššōpār wəʾet-hāhār ʿāšēn
clgloss: and-all=the-people.sg perceiving.mpl DOM=-the-thunder and-DOM=the-lightning and-DOM sound.of the-horn and-DOM=the-mountain smoky
cltranslation: And all the people (were) perceiving the thunder and the lightning and the sound of the horn and the mountain (being) smoky.

clhebrew: וְאִם־מִזְבַּ֤ח אֲבָנִים֙ תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־לִּ֔י לֹֽא־תִבְנֶ֥ה אֶתְהֶ֖ן גָּזִ֑ית
SBL_cltransliteration: wəʾim-mizbaḥ ʾăbānîm taʿăśeh-lî lōʾ-tibneh ʾethen gāzît
clgloss: and-if=altar.of stones make.2msg=for-me not=build.2msg DOM=them cut.stone
cltranslation: And if you make me an altar of stones, you must not fashion them (into) cut stone.

clhebrew: וְלֹֽא־תַעֲלֶ֥ה בְמַעֲלֹ֖ת עַֽל־מִזְבְּחִ֑י אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־תִגָּלֶ֥ה עֶרְוָתְךָ֖ עָלָֽיו
SBL_cltransliteration: wəlōʾ-taʿăleh bəmaʿălōt ʿal-mizbəḥî ʾăšer lōʾ-tiggāleh ʿerwātəkā ʿālāyw
clgloss: and-not=ascend.2msg in-stairs on=altar-my that not=be.uncovered.3fsg nakedness-your on-it
cltranslation: And you shall not ascend onto my altar with stairs (so) that your nakedness may not be uncovered on it.
notes: I have treated *ʿālâ* as bivalent ‘to go up on X,’ assuming that it selects a PP complement.

clhebrew: כִּ֤י תִקְנֶה֙ עֶ֣בֶד עִבְרִ֔י שֵׁ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים יַעֲבֹ֑ד
SBL_cltransliteration: kî tiqneh ʿebed ʿibrî šēš šānîm yaʿăbōd
clgloss: if acquire.2msg slave Hebrew six years serve.3msg
cltranslation: If you aquire a Hebrew slave, he may work (for) six years.

clhebrew: לֹ֥א אֵצֵ֖א חָפְשִֽׁי
SBL_cltransliteration: lōʾ ʾēṣēʾ ḥopšî
clgloss: not go.out.1sg free
cltranslation: I will not go out free.

clhebrew: וְרָצַ֨ע אֲדֹנָ֤יו אֶת־אָזְנוֹ֙ בַּמַּרְצֵ֔עַ
SBL_cltransliteration: wərāṣaʿ ʾădōnāyw ʾet-ʾoznô bammarṣēaʿ
clgloss: and-pierce.3msg master-his DOM=ear-his with-the-piercer
cltranslation: And his master shall pierce his ear with an awl.

clhebrew: וְכִֽי־יִמְכֹּ֥ר אִ֛ישׁ אֶת־בִּתּ֖וֹ לְאָמָ֑ה לֹ֥א תֵצֵ֖א כְּצֵ֥את הָעֲבָדִֽים
SBL_cltransliteration: wəkî-yimkōr ʾîš ʾet-bittô ləʾāmâ lōʾ tēṣēʾ kəṣēʾt hāʿăbādîm
clgloss: and-if=sell.3msg man DOM=daughter-his to-female.servant not go.out.3fsg as-going.out.of.INF the-servants
cltranslation: And if a man sells his daughter as a servant, she must not go free (in the same way) as the (male) servants do.

clhebrew: אַ֥ךְ אִם־י֛וֹם א֥וֹ יוֹמַ֖יִם יַעֲמֹ֑ד
SBL_cltransliteration: ʾak ʾim-yôm ʾô yômayim yaʿămōd
clgloss: however if=day or two.days stand.3msg
cltranslation: However, if he endures (for) a day or two days...

clhebrew: אִֽם־הִמָּצֵא֩ תִמָּצֵ֨א בְיָד֜וֹ הַגְּנֵבָ֗ה מִשּׁ֧וֹר עַד־חֲמ֛וֹר עַד־שֶׂ֖ה חַיִּ֑ים שְׁנַ֖יִם יְשַׁלֵּֽם
SBL_cltransliteration: ʾim-himmāṣēʾ timmāṣēʾ bəyādô haggənēbâ miššôr ʿad-ḥămôr ʿad-śeh ḥayyîm šənayim yəšallēm
clgloss: if=be.found.INF be.found.3fsg in-his-hand the-stolen.thing.fsg from-ox until=donkey until=sheep alive double pay.back.3msg
cltranslation: If the stolen thing – whether ox, donkey, or sheep – is found alive in his possession, he shall pay back double.

clhebrew: אִם־טָרֹ֥ף יִטָּרֵ֖ף יְבִאֵ֣הוּ עֵ֑ד הַטְּרֵפָ֖ה לֹ֥א יְשַׁלֵּֽם
SBL_cltransliteration: ʾim-ṭārōp yiṭṭārēp yəbiʾēhû ʿēd haṭṭərēpâ lōʾ yəšallēm
clgloss: if=tear be.torn.3msg bring.3msg-it witness the-torn.animal not pay.back.3msg
cltranslation: If it is torn up (by some animal), he shall bring it (as) evidence; he does not have to pay back the torn (animal).

clhebrew: וְכִֽי־יִשְׁאַ֥ל אִ֛ישׁ מֵעִ֥ם רֵעֵ֖הוּ וְנִשְׁבַּ֣ר אוֹ־מֵ֑ת בְּעָלָ֥יו אֵין־עִמּ֖וֹ שַׁלֵּ֥ם יְשַׁלֵּֽם
SBL_cltransliteration: wəkî-yišʾal ʾîš mēʿim rēʿēhû wənišbar ʾô-mēt bəʿālāyw ʾên-ʿimmô šallēm yəšallēm
clgloss: and-because=ask.3msg man from-with neighbour-his and-be.broken.3msg or=die.3msg master-it not.be=with-it pay.back pay.back.3msg
cltranslation: And if a man borrows (an animal) from his neighbour and it is injured or dies (while) its master is not with it, he must pay back (the damage).
notes: I have analyzed *bəʿālāyw ʾên-ʿimmô* as a CP, but it may rather be a negated PrP.

clhebrew: מָהֹ֛ר יִמְהָרֶ֥נָּה לּ֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה

clgloss: INF.ABS pay.bride.price.for.3msg-her to-him to-wife
cltranslation: He must acquire her for himself as a wife (by paying the bride price).

clhebrew: שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה עִם־אִמּ֔וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֖י תִּתְּנוֹ־לִֽי
SBL_cltransliteration: šibʿat yāmîm yihyeh ʿim-ʾimmô bayyôm haššəmînî tittənô-lî
clgloss: seven days be.3msg with=mother-his in-the-day the-eight give.2msg-him=to-me
cltranslation: It shall be with its mother (for) seven days. On the eight day you may give it to me.

clhebrew: וְשֵׁ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים תִּזְרַ֣ע אֶת־אַרְצֶ֑ךָ וְאָסַפְתָּ֖ אֶת־תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ
SBL_cltransliteration: wəšēš šānîm tizraʿ ʾet-ʾarṣekā wəʾāsaptā ʾet-təbûʾātāh
clgloss: and-six years sow.2msg DOM=land-your and-gather.2msg DOM=produce-its
cltranslation: And (during) six years you may sow your land and gather its produce.
notes: This is not a single sowing event that lasts six years, but rather one sowing event that may be repeated every year for six years.

clhebrew: שֵׁ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה מַעֲשֶׂ֔יךָ
SBL_cltransliteration: šēšet yāmîm taʿăśeh maʿăśêkā
clgloss: six years do.2msg work-your
cltranslation: You may do your work six days [per week].

clhebrew: שֵׁ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה מַעֲשֶׂ֔יךָ
SBL_cltransliteration: šēšet yāmîm taʿăśeh maʿăśêkā
clgloss: six years do.2msg work-your
cltranslation: You may do your work six days [per week].

clhebrew: שָׁלֹ֣שׁ רְגָלִ֔ים תָּחֹ֥ג לִ֖י בַּשָּׁנָֽה
SBL_cltransliteration: šālōš rəgālîm tāḥōg lî baššānâ
clgloss: three times celebrate.feast.2msg to-me in-the-year
cltranslation: You shall celebrate a feast to me three times during the year.

SBL_cltransliteration: šibʿat yāmîm tōʾkal maṣṣôt
clgloss: seven days eat.2msg unleavened.bread
cltranslation: (For) seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

clhebrew: וְלֹא־יֵרָא֥וּ פָנַ֖י רֵיקָֽם
SBL_cltransliteration: wəlōʾ-yērāʾû pānay rêqām
clgloss: and-not=appear.3mpl face-my empty.handed
cltranslation: And they must not appear (to) my face emptyhanded.

clhebrew: שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה יֵרָאֶה֙ כָּל־זְכ֣וּרְךָ֔ אֶל־פְּנֵ֖י הָאָדֹ֥ן ׀ יְהוָֽה
SBL_cltransliteration: šālōš pəʿāmîm baššānâ yērāʾeh kol-zəkûrkā ʾel-pənê hāʾādōn yhwh
clgloss: three times in-the-year appear.3msg every=male-your to=face.of the-lord yhwh
cltranslation: Three times per year, every one of your males shall appear to the face of the lord Yahweh.

clhebrew: וְלֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂ֖ה כְּמַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כִּ֤י הָרֵס֙ תְּהָ֣רְסֵ֔ם
SBL_cltransliteration: wəlōʾ taʿăśeh kəmaʿăśêhem kî hārēs təhārəsēm
clgloss: and-not do.2msg as-deeds-their for tear.down.IA tear.down.2msg-them
cltranslation: And you must not do according to their deeds, for you shall (rather) tear them down.
notes: Typically, the verb *ʿāśâ* is transitive, but here it may be intransitive ‘to act.’

clhebrew: וְנָתַתִּ֧י אֶת־כָּל־אֹיְבֶ֛יךָ אֵלֶ֖יךָ עֹֽרֶף
SBL_cltransliteration: wənātattî ʾet-kol-ʾōyəbêkā ʾēlêkā ʿōrep
clgloss: and-give.1sg DOM=all=enemies-your to-you back.of.neck
cltranslation: And I will give all your enemies to you (with) back (toward you).

clhebrew: וַיַּ֨עַן כָּל־הָעָ֜ם ק֤וֹל אֶחָד֙
SBL_cltransliteration: wayyaʿan kol-hāʿām qôl ʾeḥād
clgloss: and-responded.3msg all=the-people voice one
cltranslation: And the all the people responded (with) one voice.

clhebrew: וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נַעֲשֶֽׂה
SBL_cltransliteration: wayyōʾmrû kol-haddəbārîm ʾăšer-dibber yhwh naʿăśeh

cltranslation: And the said, “We will do all the words which Yahweh spoke.”

clhebrew: וַיַּֽעֲל֖וּ עֹלֹ֑ת
SBL_cltransliteration: wayyaʿălû ʿōlōt
clgloss: and-offered.up.3mpl burnt.offerings
cltranslation: And they offered up burnt offerings.

clhebrew: וַֽיִּזְבְּח֞וּ זְבָחִ֧ים שְׁלָמִ֛ים לַיהוָ֖ה פָּרִֽים
SBL_cltransliteration: wayyizbəḥû zəbāḥîm šəlāmîm layhwh pārîm
clgloss: and-sacrificed.3mpl sacrifices peace.offerings to-yhwh bulls
cltranslation: And they sacrificed bulls (as) peace-offering-sacrifices to Yahweh.
notes: I have assumed that *šəlāmîm* is in apposition to *zəbāḥîm*, so that *zəbāḥîm šəlāmîm layhwh* together forms a single capacitive SP ‘(as) peace-offering-sacrifices,’ which has been fronted ahead of the actual object *pārîm*.

clhebrew: וַיְכַסֵּ֥הוּ הֶעָנָ֖ן שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים
SBL_cltransliteration: waykassēhû heʿānān šēšet yāmîm
clgloss: and-covered.3msg-it the-cloud six days
cltranslation: And the cloud covered it (for) six days.

clhebrew: וַיְהִ֤י מֹשֶׁה֙ בָּהָ֔ר אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָֽיְלָה

cltranslation: And Moses was on the mountain (for) forty days and forty nights.

SBL_cltransliteration: wəṣippîtā ʾōtô zāhāb ṭāhôr
clgloss: and-overlay.2msg DOM-it gold pure
cltranslation: And you shall overlay it (with) pure gold.

SBL_cltransliteration: wəṣippîtā ʾōtām zāhāb
clgloss: and-overlay.2msg DOM-them gold
cltranslation: And you shall overlay them (with) gold.

clhebrew: מִקְשָׁה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם מִשְּׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת
SBL_cltransliteration: miqšâ taʿăśeh ʾōtām miššənê qəṣôt hakkappōret

cltranslation: You shall make them a hammered work at the two ends of the cover.

clhebrew: וְהָי֣וּ הַכְּרֻבִים֩ פֹּרְשֵׂ֨י כְנָפַ֜יִם לְמַ֗עְלָה סֹכְכִ֤ים בְּכַנְפֵיהֶם֙ עַל־הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת
SBL_cltransliteration: wəhāyû hakkərubîm pōrəśê kənāpayim ləmaʿlâ sōkəkîm bəkanpêhem ʿal-hakkappōret
clgloss: and-be.3pl the-cherubim spread.PTCP.mpl.of wings to-upward cover.PTCP.mpl in-wings-their over=the-cover
cltranslation: And the cherubim shall be spreading (their) wings upward (while) covering the cover with their wings.

SBL_cltransliteration: wəṣippîtā ʾōtô zāhāb ṭāhôr
clgloss: and-overlay.2msg DOM-it gold pure
cltranslation: And you shall overlay it (with) pure gold.

clhebrew: לְעֻמַּת֙ הַמִּסְגֶּ֔רֶת תִּהְיֶ֖יןָ הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן
SBL_cltransliteration: ləʿummat hammisgeret tihyênā haṭṭabbāʿōt ləbāttîm ləbaddîm lāśēʾt ʾet-haššulḥān
clgloss: beside the-border be.3fpl the-rings to-houses to-poles to-lift.INF DOM=the-table
cltranslation: The rings shall be beside the border as housings for the poles to lift the table (with).

clhebrew: וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָ֑ב
SBL_cltransliteration: wəṣippîtā ʾōtām zāhāb
clgloss: and-overlay.2msg DOM-them gold
cltranslation: And you shall overlay them (with) gold.

clhebrew: זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם
SBL_cltransliteration: zāhāb ṭāhôr taʿăśeh ʾōtām
clgloss: gold pure make.2msg DOM-it
cltranslation: You shall make it (with) pure gold.

clhebrew: מִקְשָׁ֞ה תֵּעָשֶׂ֤ה הַמְּנוֹרָה֙
SBL_cltransliteration: miqšâ tēʿāśeh hammənôrâ
clgloss: hammered.work make.2msg the-lampstand
cltranslation: You shall make the lampstand a hammered work.

clhebrew: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְ֠בִעִים מְֽשֻׁקָּדִ֞ים בַּקָּנֶ֣ה הָאֶחָד֮ כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפֶרַח֒

cltranslation: Three almond shaped bowls (shall be) on the one branch (with) ornament and flower.

SBL_cltransliteration: ûšəlōšâ gəbiʿîm məšuqqādîm baqqāneh hāʾeḥād kaptōr wāpāraḥ
clgloss: and-three bowls almond.shaped.PTCP in-the-branch the-one ornament and-flower
cltranslation: And three almond shaped bowls (shall be) on the one branch (with) ornament and flower.

clhebrew: וּבַמְּנֹרָ֖ה אַרְבָּעָ֣ה גְבִעִ֑ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֔ים כַּפְתֹּרֶ֖יהָ וּפְרָחֶֽיהָ
SBL_cltransliteration: ûbammənōrâ ʾarbāʿâ gəbiʿîm məšuqqādîm kaptōrêhā ûpərāḥêhā
clgloss: and-in-the-menorah four bowls almond.shaped.PTCP ornaments-its and-flowers-its
cltranslation: And on the menorah (shall be) four almond shaped bowls (with) its ornaments and its flowers.

SBL_cltransliteration: kikkār zāhāb ṭāhôr yaʿăśeh ʾōtāh ʾēt kol-hakkēlîm hāʾēlleh
clgloss: talent gold pure make.3msg DOM-it.fsg DOM all=the-utensils the-these
cltranslation: He shall make it (and) all these utensils (with) a talent of pure gold.

clhebrew: וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֥ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עֶ֣שֶׂר יְרִיעֹ֑ת
SBL_cltransliteration: wəʾet-hammiškān taʿăśeh ʿeśer yərîʿōt

notes: See the note on Num 34:22.

clhebrew: וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־יִשָׂשכָ֖ר נָשִׂ֑יא פַּלְטִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־עַזָּֽן
SBL_cltransliteration: ûləmaṭṭēh bənê-yiśāškār nāśîʾ palṭîʾēl ben-ʿazzān
clgloss: and-to-tribe.of sons.of=Issachar leader Paltiel son.of=Azzan
cltranslation: And for the tribe of the sons of Issachar, Paltiel son of Azzan (as) leader.
notes: See the note on Num 34:22.

clhebrew: וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־אָשֵׁ֖ר נָשִׂ֑יא אֲחִיה֖וּד בֶּן־שְׁלֹמִֽי
SBL_cltransliteration: ûləmaṭṭēh bənê-ʾāšēr nāśîʾ ʾăḥîhûd ben-šəlōmî
clgloss: and-to-tribe.of sons.of=Asher leader Ahihud son.of=Shelomi
cltranslation: And for the tribe of the sons of Asher, Ahihud son of Shelomi (as) leader.
notes: See the note on Num 34:22.

clhebrew: וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־נַפְתָּלִ֖י נָשִׂ֑יא פְּדַהְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־עַמִּיהֽוּד
SBL_cltransliteration: ûləmaṭṭēh bənê-naptālî nāśîʾ pədahʾēl ben-ʿammîhûd
clgloss: and-to-tribe.of sons.of=Naphtali leader Pedahel son.of=Ammihud
cltranslation: And for the tribe of the sons of Naphtali, Pedahel son of Ammihud (as) leader.
notes: See the note on Num 34:22.

clhebrew: וְהָי֨וּ לָכֶ֧ם הֶעָרִ֛ים לְמִקְלָ֖ט מִגֹּאֵ֑ל
SBL_cltransliteration: wəhāyû lākem heʿārîm ləmiqlāṭ miggōʾēl
clgloss: and-be.3pl to-you the-cities to-refuge from-avenger
cltranslation: And the cities will be yours as a refuge from the avenger.

clhebrew: אֶת־אֲדֹנִי֙ צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה לָתֵ֨ת אֶת־הָאָ֧רֶץ בְּנַחֲלָ֛ה בְּגוֹרָ֖ל לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
SBL_cltransliteration: ʾet-ʾădōnî ṣiwwâ yhwh lātēt ʾet-hāʾāreṣ bənaḥălâ bəgôrāl libnê yiśrāʾēl
clgloss: DOM=lord-my commanded.3msg yhwh to-give DOM=the-land in-property in-lot to-sons.of Israel
cltranslation: Yahweh commanded my lord to give the land to the sons of Israel (as) property by lot.

clhebrew: וְהָיוּ לְאֶחָ֞ד מִבְּנֵ֨י שִׁבְטֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לְנָשִׁים֒
SBL_cltransliteration: wəhāyû ləʾeḥād mibbənê šibṭê bənê-yiśrāʾēl lənāšîm
clgloss: and-be.3pl to-one from-sons.of tribes.of sons.of=Israel to-wives
cltranslation: And if they become wives to one of the men of the sons of Israel...
notes: The benefactive PP is focus-fronted.

clhebrew: לַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה לְנָשִׁ֑ים
SBL_cltransliteration: laṭṭôb bəʿênêhem tihyênâ lənāšîm
clgloss: to-the-good in-eyes-their be.3fpl to-wives
cltranslation: They may be wives (according) to what is good in their eyes.

clhebrew: אַ֗ךְ לְמִשְׁפַּ֛חַת מַטֵּ֥ה אֲבִיהֶ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֥ינָה לְנָשִֽׁים
SBL_cltransliteration: ʾak ləmišpaḥat maṭṭēh ʾăbîhem tihyênâ lənāšîm
clgloss: only to-family.of tribe.of father-their be.3fpl to-wives
cltranslation: Only, they must be wives to the family of the tribe of their father.
notes: The benefactive PP is focus-fronted.

clhebrew: וְכָל־בַּ֞ת יֹרֶ֣שֶׁת נַחֲלָ֗ה מִמַּטּוֹת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לְאֶחָ֗ד מִמִּשְׁפַּ֛חַת מַטֵּ֥ה אָבִ֖יהָ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לְאִשָּׁ֑ה
SBL_cltransliteration: wəkol-bat yōrešet naḥălâ mimmaṭṭôt bənê yiśrāʾēl ləʾeḥād mimmišpaḥat maṭṭēh ʾābîhā tihyeh ləʾiššâ
clgloss: and-every=daughter possessing property from-tribes.of sons.of Israel to-one from-family.of tribe.of father-her be.3fsg to-wife
cltranslation: And every woman who possesses a property from among the tribes of the sons of Israel must be a wife to someone from the family of the tribe of her father.
notes: The benefactive PP is focus-fronted.

clhebrew: וַתִּהְיֶ֜ינָה מַחְלָ֣ה תִרְצָ֗ה וְחָגְלָ֧ה וּמִלְכָּ֛ה וְנֹעָ֖ה בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָ֑ד לִבְנֵ֥י דֹדֵיהֶ֖ן לְנָשִֽׁים
SBL_cltransliteration: wattihyênâ maḥlâ tirṣâ wəḥāgəlâ ûmilkâ wənōʿâ bənôt ṣəlāpəḥād libnê dōdêhen lənāšîm
clgloss: and-were.3fpl Mahlah Tirzah and-Hoglah and-Milkah and-Noah daughters.of Zelophehad to-sons.of uncles-their to-wives
cltranslation: And Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milkah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, became wives to the sons of their uncles.
notes: One way to explain the word order (i.e. with the benefactive PP ahead of the complement) is to assume that the subject names are in a fronted topic position, which is naturally ahead of the benefactive PP in its fronted focus position.

clhebrew: מִֽמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֛ת בְּנֵֽי־מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בֶן־יוֹסֵ֖ף הָי֣וּ לְנָשִׁ֑ים
SBL_cltransliteration: mimmišpəḥōt bənê-mənaššeh ben-yôsēp hāyû lənāšîm
clgloss: from-families.of sons.of=Manasseh son.of=Joseph were.3pl to-wives
cltranslation: They were wives (to men) from the families of the sons of Manasseh, the son of Joseph.
notes: The benefactive constituent is focus-fronted, with something like *ləbānîm* ‘to sons’ understood.

clhebrew: וְכִסּ֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ בְּמִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ
SBL_cltransliteration: wəkissû ʾōtô bəmiksēh ʿôr tāḥaš
clgloss: and-cover.3msg DOM-it with-covering.of skin.of porpoise
cltranslation: And they shall cover it with a covering of porpoise skin.

clhebrew: וְכִסּ֣וּ אוֹתָ֔ם בְּמִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ
SBL_cltransliteration: wəkissû ʾôtām bəmiksēh ʿôr tāḥaš
clgloss: and-cover.3msg DOM-them with-covering.of skin.of porpoise
cltranslation: And they shall cover them with a covering of porpoise skin.

clhebrew: אֵ֣לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּעֵ֖בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן
SBL_cltransliteration: ʾēlleh haddəbārîm ʾăšer dibber mōšeh ʾel-kol-yiśrāʾēl bəʿēber hayyardēn
clgloss: these the-words which spoke.3msg Moses to=all=Israel in-other.side.of the-Jordan
cltranslation: These (are) the words which Moses spoke to all Israel on the other side of the Jordan.

clhebrew: וְהִנְּכֶ֣ם הַיּ֔וֹם כְּכוֹכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָרֹֽב
SBL_cltransliteration: wəhinnəkem hayyôm kəkôkəbê haššāmayim lārōb
clgloss: and-behold-you the-day as-stars.of the-heavens for-abundance
cltranslation: And behold, today you (are) like the stars of the heavens in abundance.

clhebrew: וַתֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ טֽוֹב־הַדָּבָ֥ר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת
SBL_cltransliteration: wattōʾmrû ṭôb-haddābār ʾăšer-dibbartā laʿăśôt
clgloss: and-said.2mpl good=the-word which=spoke.2msg to-do.INF
cltranslation: And you said, “The word which you spoke to do (is) good.”

clhebrew: וָאֶתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛ם רָאשִׁ֖ים עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם שָׂרֵ֨י אֲלָפִ֜ים וְשָׂרֵ֣י מֵא֗וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֤י חֲמִשִּׁים֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י עֲשָׂרֹ֔ת וְשֹׁטְרִ֖ים לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶֽם
SBL_cltransliteration: wāʾettēn ʾōtām rāʾšîm ʿălêkem śārê ʾălāpîm wəśārê mēʾôt wəśārê ḥămiššîm wəśārê ʿăśārōt wəšōṭərîm ləšibṭêkem
clgloss: and-gave.1sg DOM-them heads over-you leaders.of thousands and-leaders.of hundreds and-leaders.of fifties and-leaders.of tens and-officials for-tribes-your
cltranslation: And I made them heads over you, (namely) leaders of thousands, leaders of hundreds, leaders of fifties, leaders of tens, and officials for your tribes.
notes: The analysis assumes that נתן here functions much like שׂים, as it does in some places where the meaning is ‘place, set’ rather than ‘give.’ However, it is also possible to assume the meaning ‘give,’ in which case the SP is a capacitive, not a complementative.

clhebrew: שָׁמֹ֤עַ בֵּין־אֲחֵיכֶם֙ וּשְׁפַטְתֶּ֣ם צֶ֔דֶק בֵּֽין־אִ֥ישׁ וּבֵין־אָחִ֖יו וּבֵ֥ין גֵּרֽוֹ
SBL_cltransliteration: šāmōaʿ bên-ʾăḥêkem ûšəpaṭtem ṣedeq bên-ʾîš ûbên-ʾāḥîw ûbên gērô
clgloss: hear.IA between=brothers-your and-judge.2mpl righteousness between=man and-between=brother-his and-between foreign.guest-his
cltranslation: By hearing your brothers out, you shall judge (with) righteousness between a man and his fellow countryman or his foreign guest.
notes: Alternatively, this could be considered a manner modifier equivalent to ‘righteously.’

clhebrew: וַנֵּ֡לֶךְ אֵ֣ת כָּל־הַמִּדְבָּ֣ר הַגָּדוֹל֩ וְהַנּוֹרָ֨א הַה֜וּא אֲשֶׁ֣ר רְאִיתֶ֗ם דֶּ֚רֶךְ הַ֣ר הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ אֹתָ֑נוּ
SBL_cltransliteration: wannēlek ʾēt kol-hammidbār haggādôl wəhannôrāʾ hahûʾ ʾăšer rəʾîtem derek har hāʾĕmōrî kaʾăšer ṣiwwâ yhwh ʾĕlōhênû ʾōtānû
clgloss: and-walked.1cpl DOM all=the-wilderness the-big and-the-fearsome the-that which saw.2mpl way.of mount.of the-Amorite as-which commanded.3msg yhwh God-our DOM-us
cltranslation: And we walked that entire big and fearsome wilderness which you saw (on) the way (to) the mountainous country of the Amorites as Yahweh our God commanded us.

clhebrew: הַהֹלֵ֨ךְ לִפְנֵיכֶ֜ם בַּדֶּ֗רֶךְ לָת֥וּר לָכֶ֛ם מָק֖וֹם לַֽחֲנֹֽתְכֶ֑ם בָּאֵ֣שׁ ׀ לַ֗יְלָה לַרְאֹֽתְכֶם֙ בַּדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽלְכוּ־בָ֔הּ וּבֶעָנָ֖ן יוֹמָֽם
SBL_cltransliteration: hahōlēk lipnêkem badderek lātûr lākem māqôm laḥănōtəkem bāʾēš laylâ larʾōtəkem badderek ʾăšer tēləkû-bāh ûbeʿānān yômām
clgloss: the-walk.PTCP before-you in-the-way to-spy.INF for-you place to-camp.INF-your in-the-fire night to-see.INF-your in-the-way which walk.2mpl=in-it and-in-the-cloud by.day
cltranslation: ... the one who walks before you on the road to spy out for you a place for you to camp, in the fire (by) night for you to see on the road by which you walk and in the cloud by day.

clhebrew: וְטַפְּכֶם֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֜ם לָבַ֣ז יִהְיֶ֗ה וּ֠בְנֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־יָדְע֤וּ הַיּוֹם֙ ט֣וֹב וָרָ֔ע הֵ֖מָּה יָבֹ֣אוּ שָׁ֑מָּה
SBL_cltransliteration: wəṭappəkem ʾăšer ʾămartem lābaz yihyeh ûbənêkem ʾăšer lōʾ-yādəʿû hayyôm ṭôb wārāʿ hēmmâ yābōʾû šāmmâ
clgloss: and-children-your which said.2mpl for-plunder be.3msg and-sons-your which not=know.3pl the-day good and-evil they enter.3mpl there-toward
cltranslation: And (as) for your children, of whom you said that they would be for plunder, and your sons who do not know good and evil today, they (are the ones who) will enter there.

clhebrew: וְאַתֶּ֖ם פְּנ֣וּ לָכֶ֑ם וּסְע֥וּ הַמִּדְבָּ֖רָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ יַם־סֽוּף
SBL_cltransliteration: wəʾattem pənû lākem ûsəʿû hammidbārâ derek yam-sûp
clgloss: and-you turn.2mpl.IMP for-you and-set.out.2mpl.IMP the-wilderness-toward way.of sea.of=reed
cltranslation: And you, turn yourselves around and set out into the wilderness (by) the way of the Sea of Reeds.

clhebrew: וַתֵּשְׁב֥וּ בְקָדֵ֖שׁ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים כַּיָּמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשַׁבְתֶּֽם
SBL_cltransliteration: wattēšəbû bəqādēš yāmîm rabbîm kayyāmîm ʾăšer yəšabtem
clgloss: and-lived.2mpl in-Kadesh days many as-the-days which lived.2mpl
cltranslation: And you lived in Kadesh (for) many days, as the days which you have lived.

clhebrew: וַנֵּ֜פֶן וַנִּסַּ֤ע הַמִּדְבָּ֙רָה֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יַם־ס֔וּף כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י
SBL_cltransliteration: wannēpen wannissaʿ hammidbārâ derek yam-sûp kaʾăšer dibber yhwh ʾēlāy
clgloss: and-turned.1pl and-set.out.1pl the-wilderness-toward way.of sea.of=reed as-which spoke.3msg yhwh to-me
cltranslation: And we turned around and set out into the wilderness (by) the way of the Sea of Reeds just as Yahweh spoke to me.

clhebrew: וַנָּ֥סָב אֶת־הַר־שֵׂעִ֖יר יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים
SBL_cltransliteration: wannāsāb ʾet-har-śēʿîr yāmîm rabbîm
clgloss: and-circumvented.1pl DOM=mountain.of=Seir days many
cltranslation: And we circumvented Mount Seir (for) many days.

clhebrew: זֶ֣ה ׀ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ
SBL_cltransliteration: zeh ʾarbāʿîm šānâ yhwh ʾĕlōhêkā ʿimmāk
clgloss: this forty year yhwh God-your with-you
cltranslation: Yahweh your God (has been) with you, this (is) forty years.

clhebrew: וַֽנַּעֲבֹ֔ר דֶּ֖רֶךְ מִדְבַּ֥ר מוֹאָֽב
SBL_cltransliteration: wannaʿăbōr derek midbar môʾāb
clgloss: and-passed.through.1pl way.of wilderness.of Moab
cltranslation: And we passed through (by) the way of the wilderness of Moab.

clhebrew: כִּי לֹֽא־אֶתֵּ֨ן לְךָ֤ מֵֽאַרְצוֹ֙ יְרֻשָּׁ֔ה
SBL_cltransliteration: kî lōʾ-ʾettēn ləkā mēʾarṣô yəruššâ
clgloss: because not=give.1sg to-you from-land-his possession
cltranslation: For I will not give (any) of his land to you (as) a possession.

clhebrew: כִּ֣י לִבְנֵי־ל֔וֹט נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־עָ֖ר יְרֻשָּֽׁה
SBL_cltransliteration: kî libnê-lôṭ nātattî ʾet-ʿār yəruššâ
clgloss: because to-sons.of=Lot gave.1sg DOM=Ar posession
cltranslation: For I have given Ar to the sons of Lot (as) a possession.

clhebrew: רְפָאִ֛ים יֵחָשְׁב֥וּ אַף־הֵ֖ם כָּעֲנָקִ֑ים
SBL_cltransliteration: rəpāʾîm yēḥāšəbû ʾap-hēm kāʿănāqîm
clgloss: rephaim be.considered.3mpl also=they like-the-Anakim
cltranslation: They too are considered Rephaim, like the Anakim (are).

clhebrew: אַתָּ֨ה עֹבֵ֥ר הַיּ֛וֹם אֶת־גְּב֥וּל מוֹאָ֖ב אֶת־עָֽר
SBL_cltransliteration: ʾattâ ʿōbēr hayyôm ʾet-gəbûl môʾāb ʾet-ʿār
clgloss: you cross.PTCP the-day DOM=border.of Moab DOM=Ar
cltranslation: You (are) crossing the border of Moab today, (namely) Ar.

clhebrew: כִּ֣י לֹֽא־אֶ֠תֵּן מֵאֶ֨רֶץ בְּנֵי־עַמּ֤וֹן לְךָ֙ יְרֻשָּׁ֔ה
SBL_cltransliteration: kî lōʾ-ʾettēn mēʾereṣ bənê-ʿammôn ləkā yəruššâ
clgloss: for not=give.1sg from-land.of sons.of=Ammon to-you possession
cltranslation: For I will not give (any) of the land of the sons of Ammon to you (as) a possession.

clhebrew: כִּ֥י לִבְנֵי־ל֖וֹט נְתַתִּ֥יהָ יְרֻשָּֽׁה
SBL_cltransliteration: kî libnê-lôṭ nətattîhā yəruššâ
clgloss: for to-sons.of=Lot gave.1sg-it possession
cltranslation: For I have given it to the sons of Lot (as) a possession.

clhebrew: אֶֽרֶץ־רְפָאִ֥ים תֵּחָשֵׁ֖ב אַף־הִ֑וא
SBL_cltransliteration: ʾereṣ-rəpāʾîm tēḥāšēb ʾap-hiwʾ
clgloss: land.of-Rephaim be.reckoned.3fsg also=it
cltranslation: It is also considered (to be) the land of the Rephaim.

cltranslation: And we turned around and went up (by) the way of Bashan.

cltranslation: And Og, king of Bashan, came out to meet us, he and all his people, for battle (at) Edre’i.

cltranslation: All these (were) fortified cities (with) high wall, double doors, and gate-bar...

cltranslation: You shall cross over armed ahead of your brothers, the sons of Israel – all the fighting men.

cltranslation: And you who have clung to Yahweh your god (are) alive – all of you – today.

cltranslation: And who (is) a great nation which has righteous statutes and judgements like this whole law which I (am) putting before you today?

cltranslation: ... and I will make them hear the words which they must learn (so as) to fear me all the days which they (are) alive upon the earth.

cltranslation: And He brought you out of the iron furnace, from Egypt, to be a people of possession to Him as (is the case) today.

SBL_cltransliteration: wəšāmartā ʾet-ḥuqqāyw wəʾet-miṣwōtāyw ʾăšer ʾānōkî məṣawwəkā hayyôm ʾăšer yîṭab ləkā ûləbānêkā ʾaḥărêkā ûləmaʿan taʾărîk yāmîm ʿal-haʾădāmâ ʾăšer yhwh ʾĕlōhêkā nōtēn ləkā kol-hayyāmîm

cltranslation: And keep his statutes and his commands which I (am) giving you today (so) that it may go well for you and for you children after you and so that you may extend days upon the land which Yahweh your God (is) giving to you (for) all time.

cltranslation: And they took possession of his land and the land of Og, king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites who (were) across the Jordan (towards) the sunrise.

cltranslation: You shall not bow down to them nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, (am) a jealous god, accounting (the) iniquity of fathers to sons and to (the) third and fourth (generation) to those who hate me.

xpgloss: accounting.PTCP.msg inquity.of fathers on=sons and-on=third and-on=fourth to-haters-my

clhebrew: שֵׁ֤֣שֶׁת יָמִ֣ים֙ תַּֽעֲבֹ֔ד֮ וְעָשִׂ֖֣יתָ כָּֿל־מְלַאכְתֶּֽךָ֒

cltranslation: Six days (per week) you may work and do all your work.

clhebrew: אֶֽת־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֡לֶּה דִּבֶּר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶל־כָּל־קְהַלְכֶ֜ם בָּהָ֗ר מִתּ֤וֹךְ הָאֵשׁ֙ הֶֽעָנָ֣ן וְהָֽעֲרָפֶ֔ל ק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל וְלֹ֣א יָסָ֑ף

clgloss: DOM=the-words the-these spoke.3msg yhwh to=all=assembly-your in-the-mountain from-middle.of the-fire the-cloud and-the-thick.darkness voice big and-not add.3msg
cltranslation: Yahweh spoke these words to your entire assembly on the mountain from the midst of the fire, the cloud, and the thick darkness (with) a big voice and he did not add (anything).

clhebrew: אֶֽת־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֡לֶּה דִּבֶּר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶל־כָּל־קְהַלְכֶ֜ם בָּהָ֗ר מִתּ֤וֹךְ הָאֵשׁ֙ הֶֽעָנָ֣ן וְהָֽעֲרָפֶ֔ל ק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל וְלֹ֣א יָסָ֑ף

cltranslation: Yahweh spoke these words to your entire assembly on the mountain from the midst of the fire, the cloud, and the thick darkness (with) a big voice and he did not add (anything).

clhebrew: הַיּ֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ רָאִ֔ינוּ כִּֽי־יְדַבֵּ֧ר אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֖ם וָחָֽי

cltranslation: This day we have seen that God can speak with humanity and it (go on) living.

clhebrew: כִּ֣י מִ֣י כָל־בָּשָׂ֡ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֣ע קוֹל֩ אֱלֹהִ֨ים חַיִּ֜ים מְדַבֵּ֧ר מִתּוֹךְ־הָאֵ֛שׁ כָּמֹ֖נוּ וַיֶּֽחִי

cltranslation: For who (is there among) all mortal (beings) that has heard the voice of the living God speaking from within the fire like we (have) and lived.

clhebrew: שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת־ק֨וֹל דִּבְרֵ֜י הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבְּר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ

cltranslation: I heard the sound of the words of this people which they spoke to you.

clhebrew: וְלִשְׁמֹ֥ר אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֹתַ֖י כָּל־הַיָּמִ֑ים
SBL_cltransliteration: wəlišmōr ʾet-kol-miṣwōtay kol-hayyāmîm
clgloss: and-to-keep.INF DOM=all=commands-my all=the-days
cltranslation: ... and to keep my commands (for) all time...

clhebrew: לֹ֥א תָסֻ֖רוּ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאל
SBL_cltransliteration: lōʾ tāsurû yāmîn ûśəmōʾl
clgloss: not turn.2msg right.hand and-left.hand
cltranslation: You must not turn aside (to the) right or left.

clhebrew: לְמַ֨עַן תִּירָ֜א אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ לִ֠שְׁמֹר אֶת־כָּל־חֻקֹּתָ֣יו וּמִצְוֹתָיו֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י מְצַוֶּךָ֒ אַתָּה֙ וּבִנְךָ֣ וּבֶן־בִּנְךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּ֑יךָ

cltranslation: ... so that you may fear Yahweh your God (so as) to keep all his statutes and his commands which I (am) commanding you – you and your son and your son’s son – all the days of your life.

clhebrew: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֤ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֣ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר֙ יִיטַ֣ב לְךָ֔ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְבּ֖וּן מְאֹ֑ד כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ לָ֔ךְ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ

cltranslation: Israel, listen and be careful to do (what you hear) (so) that it may go well for you and (so) that you may multiply much – as Yahweh the God of your fathers spoke to you – (in) a land flowing with milk and honey.

clhebrew: וְהָי֞וּ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם עַל־לְבָבֶֽךָ

cltranslation: These words, which I (am) commanding you today, shall be on your heart.

clhebrew: כִּֽי־יִשְׁאָלְךָ֥ בִנְךָ֛ מָחָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר

cltranslation: ... (so as) to fear Yahweh our God for our good (for) all time...

cltranslation: Yahweh your God chose you to be a people of property for Him out of all the peoples who (are) on the face of the earth.

cltranslation: Because Yahweh loved you and kept the oath which he swore to your fathers, Yahweh has brought you out with a strong hand.

cltranslation: And you shall keep the command and the statutes and the judgments which I (am) commanding you today (so as) to do them.

cltranslation: and Yahweh your God will remove these nations before you little by little.
notes: BDB and DCH list *məʿaṭ* as a noun (substantive).

clhebrew: וְהָמָם֙ מְהוּמָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֔ה עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽם

cltranslation: You shall keep the whole command which I (am) commanding you today (so as) to do (it)...

cltranslation: And you shall remember the whole way that Yahweh your God has made you walk, this (is) forty years in the wilderness.

clhebrew: שִׂמְלָ֨תְךָ֜ לֹ֤א בָֽלְתָה֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יךָ וְרַגְלְךָ֖ לֹ֣א בָצֵ֑קָה זֶ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה

cltranslation: Your garment has not worn out from upon you and your foot has not swollen, this (is) forty years.

cltranslation: ... which I (am) commanding you today.

cltranslation: I testify against you today that you will certainly perish.

cltranslation: Hear, O Israel, today you are crossing the Jordan to enter to dispossess greater and mightier nations than you, (including) great cities fortified to the heavens.

clhebrew: וְיָדַעְתָּ֣ הַיּ֗וֹם כִּי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ הֽוּא־הָעֹבֵ֤ר לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙
SBL_cltransliteration: wəyādaʿtā hayyôm kî yhwh ʾĕlōhêkā hûʾ-hāʿōbēr ləpānêkā
clgloss: and-know.2msg the-day that yhwh God-your he=the-cross.PTCP before-you
cltranslation: And know today that Yahweh your God, He (is) the one crossing before you.

clhebrew: וָאֵשֵׁ֣ב בָּהָ֗ר אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְאַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה

cltranslation: And I remained on the mountain (for) forty days and forty nights.

cltranslation: There they shall sacrifice sacrifices of righteousness.

clhebrew: וַיֵּתֵא֙ רָ֣אשֵׁי עָ֔ם
SBL_cltransliteration: wayyētēʾ rāʾšê ʿām
clgloss: and-came.3msg heads.of people
cltranslation: And he came (with) (the) leaders of (the) people.

clhebrew: אֵ֥ין כָּאֵ֖ל יְשֻׁר֑וּן רֹכֵ֤ב שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ בְעֶזְרֶ֔ךָ
SBL_cltransliteration: ʾên kāʾēl yəšurûn rōkēb šāmayim bəʿezrekā
clgloss: is.not like-god.of Jeshurun riding.on sky in-help-your
cltranslation: There is no one like the God of Jeshurun (who) rides (the) sky (to be) your help...

clhebrew: וּבְגַאֲוָת֖וֹ שְׁחָקִֽים
SBL_cltransliteration: ûbəgaʾăwātô šəḥāqîm
clgloss: and-in-majesty-his clouds
cltranslation: ...and (of whom) clouds (are) his majesty

clhebrew: וַיִּשְׁכֹּן֩ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל בֶּ֤טַח
SBL_cltransliteration: wayyiškōn yiśrāʾēl beṭaḥ
clgloss: and-dwelled.3msg Israel security
cltranslation: And Israel dwelled (in) security.

clhebrew: וַיִּבְכּוּ֩ בְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֛ה בְּעַֽרְבֹ֥ת מוֹאָ֖ב שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים י֑וֹם
SBL_cltransliteration: wayyibkû bənê yiśrāʾēl ʾet-mōšeh bəʿarbōt môʾāb šəlōšîm yôm
clgloss: and-mourned.3mpl sons.of Israel DOM=Moses in-plains.of Moab thirty day
cltranslation: And the sons of Israel mourned Moses in the plains of Moab (for) thirty days.

clhebrew: וִֽיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֗וּן מָלֵא֙ ר֣וּחַ חָכְמָ֔ה כִּֽי־סָמַ֥ךְ מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־יָדָ֖יו עָלָ֑יו
SBL_cltransliteration: wîhôšuʿa bin-nûn mālēʾ rûaḥ ḥokmâ kî-sāmak mōšeh ʾet-yādāyw ʿālāyw
clgloss: and-Joshua son.of=Nun was.full.3msg spirit.of wisdom for=laid.3msg Moses DOM=hands-his on-him
cltranslation: And Joshua son of Nun was filled (with) a spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him.

clhebrew: וְלֹֽא־קָ֨ם נָבִ֥יא ע֛וֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כְּמֹשֶׁ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יְדָע֣וֹ יְהוָ֔ה פָּנִ֖ים אֶל־פָּנִֽים
SBL_cltransliteration: wəlōʾ-qām nābîʾ ʿôd bəyiśrāʾēl kəmōšeh ʾăšer yədāʿô yhwh pānîm ʾel-pānîm
clgloss: and-not=rose.3msg prophet again in-Israel like-Moses who knew.3msg-him yhwh face to=face
cltranslation: And no prophet has again arisen in Israel like Moses whom Yahweh knew face to face.
